Mesa / llvmpipe software OpenGL renderer

Qt's Windows distributions include the Mesa software renderer as opengl32sw.dll.
Upstream attribution: https://doc.qt.io/qtcreator/qtcreator-binary-attribution-llvmpipe.html
Project: https://www.mesa3d.org/
